items.title: `docs_enum_parity` keys std enums by bare name, last one wins: two std enums with one name are checked as one
items.discussion: met by lane gfx-s2: `std::gfx`'s key enum first shared the name `Key` with `std::process::Key` and the gate compared the wrong arms, so the lane renamed it `KeyName`; benign today for the two `FocusContainment` enums (same arms)
items.body: Key the table by module path plus name, so a docs page's enum is checked against the enum of the module the page documents. Then decide whether `std::gfx::KeyName` goes back to `Key`.

items.title: Rust backend: a GUARDED match leg that binds a `match`'s whole `str` subject is refused as unsupported
items.discussion: lane gfx-s2 fixed the unguarded form (the binding is an `Rc<str>` again inside the body) and refuses the guarded one by name rather than emit Rust that does not build; the JavaScript backend accepts both
items.body: Emit the guard against the `&str` binding, or rebind before the guard. Pin on both backends beside `a_str_match_that_binds_its_subject_reads_a_str_on_both_backends`.
